requirements.quote: Add a `whatsapp_link` table (user, workspace, E.164 number, verified_at, consent_at, categories) and an OTP challenge table with expiry and attempt limits
add `whatsapp` to the `notification_channel` enum (migration, next free number)
Core service: request OTP, verify, unlink (unlink stops all messages), set categories.
Messages may only ever target the verified number of the owning user (D-029).
Register tables (db index test, RLS catalog, seeders) and core exports (cross-tenant registry with real cases).
Acceptance: opt-in and verification required before any message; unlink stops messages; cross-tenant tests pass.

deliverables.change: New tenantTable whatsapp_link (workspace_id, user_id, e164 with CHECK, verified_at, consent_at, unlinked_at, categories text[], unique per workspace+user) and whatsapp_otp_challenge (code hash, expires_at, attempts with CHECK cap, consumed_at). Export from schema/index.ts.

Next free migration (renumber if base took it) creating both tables with FORCE RLS ws_isolation and grants, plus ALTER TYPE notification_channel ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'whatsapp'; update meta/_journal.json and snapshot (drizzle-kit generate, then hand-add grants/RLS as in 20261024110000_portfolio.sql).
Add 'whatsapp' to CHANNELS; no category lists it as default.

New domain (plus sibling files): requestWhatsAppOtp, verifyWhatsAppOtp, unlinkWhatsApp, setWhatsAppCategories, getWhatsAppSendTarget (only verified+consented+not-unlinked number of the owning user). OTP hashed, constant-time compare, expiry, attempt cap, resend cooldown; sender injected.
Add ./whatsapp-link subpath export; also export from packages/core/src/index.ts.
TABLE_TESTS for both tables; SERVICE_TESTS for each service export, NOT_A_SERVICE for pure ones.
Real cases: B on A's link/OTP is denied or sees nothing; A unchanged.
Add both tables to the RLS catalog.
Add both tables to the root table list.
Add both tables to PURGE_ORDER (challenge before link if cited).
Export whatsapp_link (number masked or included, categories, timestamps); exclude code hashes / challenge table.
Document the whatsapp-link domain and its dependencies.
Add whatsapp-link to CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES (audit only if audited).
Regression tests: no send target before verify/consent, OTP expiry, attempt cap, wrong code, unlink stops target, categories, number is E.164, target never another user's number.

preserve.what: packages/notifications/src/service.ts fan-out stays email/push only (line ~239); whatsapp sends are #679, no message is sent by this change
Existing notification preference behaviour: categories' defaultChannels unchanged, so whatsapp defaults off (service.ts resolve)

pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/index.test.ts src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts src/__tests__/cross-tenant --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-2}

decisions.choice: New core domain `whatsapp-link` rather than extending `whatsapp` (chat import)
decisions.justification: Separate concern and dependency set; domains registered via CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES and docs/engineering/core-domains.md:211-240
